connector.name: Homecastr MCP
connector.registryDescription: U.S. property forecasts, public benchmarks, and permit or environmental context through MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package homecastr-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dhardestylewis account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HOMECASTR_API_KEY
env.description: Homecastr API key. Use 'hc_demo_public_readonly' for free demo access (rate-limited). Get a full key at homecastr.com.

env.name: HOMECASTR_API_URL
env.description: Base URL for the Homecastr API. Defaults to https://www.homecastr.com - only override for self-hosted or staging environments.

env.name: WORLDCASTR_API_KEY
env.description: Worldcastr alias for the same API credential. HOMECASTR_API_KEY takes precedence when both are set.

env.name: WORLDCASTR_API_URL
env.description: Worldcastr API base URL. Set to https://worldcastr.com. HOMECASTR_API_URL takes precedence when both are set.
